surfaces.description: Standalone mobile build (vite.mobile.config.ts -> dist/m/), served by the same gateway StaticFiles mount. Not a federated remote — it boots itself.

notes: The only rail that keeps TWO models resident at once (answer + embedder) AND runs server-side voice in both directions: Kokoro via /v1/tts_light for output, faster-whisper via /v1/transcribe for input. Both are non-evicting, which is the whole reason the co-residency holds.
Serves /api/capabilities rather than /api/models because the UI renders corpus and voice state alongside the chips.
